      "body": "The article announces that seven issuers will enter their cum‑dividend periods in the Regular and Negotiated markets from 5 October to 12 October 2026. The list comprises United Tractors (UNTR), Astra Graphia (ASGR), Astra Agro Lestari (AALI), Astra International (ASII) – the parent company of the Astra Group – Golden Energy Mines (GEMS) from the Sinarmas Group, Teladan Prima Agro (TLDN), and Toba Surimi Industries (CRAB), with CRAB opening on 5 October.       "title": "Foreign Investors Bought These 10 Stocks in a Week as IHSG Slid to 6,036",
      "body": "The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) rebounded 0.46% to 6,036.88 on Friday (2/10/2026), but still fell 3.28% over the week amid foreign net selling of Rp 4.32 trillion across all markets, including Rp 1.27 trillion on Friday. Despite the pressure, foreign investors posted net buys in several stocks. The largest weekly foreign net buys went to PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) at Rp 88.03 billion, followed by PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) at Rp 74.44 billion and PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) at Rp 62.56 billion.       "title": "Share Buybacks Surge Toward End of 2026, With Analysts Highlighting Key Issuers",
      "body": "A wave of share buyback announcements by Indonesian issuers toward the end of 2026 is seen as a signal of management confidence and potential price support. Within the Astra International group, two subsidiaries announced buyback plans: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) with up to Rp 2 trillion and PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk (AALI) with Rp 400 billion. Other issuers preparing buyback funds include PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) with Rp 500 billion, PT Harum Energy Tbk (HRUM) with Rp 120 billion, PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) with Rp 1.38 trillion, and PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) with Rp 500 billion. Analysts note buyback effectiveness depends on fund size relative to market capitalization and actual realization, with UNTR's move signaling undervaluation after first-semester profit fell 88.2% due to RKAB and Martabe mine issues, while TOWR is viewed as attractive at a PER of 6.5x and PBV of 0.8x with a short-term target of Rp 450-Rp 500 and long-term target of Rp 600-Rp 650.",

      "title": "Astra International (ASII) to distribute Rp3.9 trillion interim dividend amid Rp8 trillion buyback",
      "body": "PT Astra International Tbk (ASII), the holding company of Astra Group, will distribute an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 totaling Rp3.9 trillion, or Rp98 per share, at the end of October 2026, matching the fiscal 2025 interim allocation despite net profit of Rp12.53 trillion as of June 2026. The cum and ex dates are 12 and 13 October for the regular and negotiation markets, and 14 and 15 October for the cash market. ASII is also conducting a buyback running from July 2026 to July 2027, with treasury shares at 1.54% of issued and paid-up capital and free float stable at 43.4%. The company will also receive proportional dividends from its subsidiaries PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR), around Rp307.52 billion, and PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk (AALI), Rp357.78 billion, totaling Rp665.30 billion. ASII's share price fell 1.28% over the past week and 31.91% year-to-date, closing at Rp4,630 on 2 October.",

      "body": "Several issuers on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) have announced share buyback plans ahead of the end of 2026, with allocated funds ranging from Rp 120 billion to Rp 2 trillion.       "body": "Several Indonesian issuers announced share buyback plans heading into the end of 2026 to support stock prices and signal management confidence.       "body": "PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR), an information technology solutions provider, has revised its fiscal year 2026 dividend plan by canceling the interim dividend scheme and converting it into an additional final cash dividend, keeping the total payout unchanged at no less than Rp 400.05 billion, or Rp 297 per share.       "body": "MITI signed a Memorandum of Understanding with PT CNEC Engineering Indonesia (CNEC INA), a subsidiary of China Nuclear Engineering & Construction Corporation, to develop three silica sand mining concessions owned by its subsidiary, covering exploration, feasibility studies, and technical engineering with potential funding support.
